module: UI elements shared by the road (DecalRoad) and river editors: highlight color palette (hover, selection, nodes, duplication...), node size factor, and the "Add Road/Nodes" toolbar button that activates creation mode. Used notably by editor_roadEditor.
notes: editModeToolbar reads M.isRoad (true = "Road", otherwise "River") and writes M.createMode; these two fields are not defined by this file, they must be set by the calling editor.
Creation mode is active if the button has been activated OR if the Alt key is pressed (editor.keyModifiers.alt).

highlightColors.desc: Highlight colors: hover, lightHover, hoverSelectNotAllowed, lightHoverSelectNotAllowed, selected, darkSelected, duplicated, nearby, cursor, createModeCursor, selectedNode, hoveredNode, node, nodeTransparent.

editModeToolbar.desc: Draws in the toolbar the "Add Road/Nodes" icon button (tooltip included), toggles the button state on click and updates M.createMode (button active or Alt pressed). Called by the road or river editor UI.
